The Observatory

Through the telescope is your chart, opened out into a sky you can travel. Every celestial body and point stands at the place it held the moment you were born, and as you come close to one it grows from a glyph into a world.

About Us

inCommon

A place to look closer, and to find what is shared.
inCommon is a space for self-reflection. Astrology, Human Design and numerology sit beside a private journal, so your own patterns can be looked at over time, and what you hold in common with the people around you can come into view.
Nothing here decides who to be. A chart is a set of questions held up to the light, and your own experience is the final authority. Whatever you find is yours to keep, to question, or to set down.
Two whole circles, and the light where they meet. The same sky turns over everyone, and the name is a promise to keep looking for the threads between people rather than the walls. Here, everyone has something in common.
My ChartsOne birth, read three ways.
The LibraryRooms to study, to write and to read.
The OracleA reading, only when it is asked for.
The ThroughlineYour own record, held over time.

A place to look closer, and to find what is shared.
inCommon is a space for self-reflection. Astrology, Human Design and numerology sit beside a private journal, so your own patterns can be looked at over time, and what you hold in common with the people around you can come into view.
Nothing here decides who to be. A chart is a set of questions held up to the light, and your own experience is the final authority. Whatever you find is yours to keep, to question, or to set down.
Two whole circles, and the light where they meet. The same sky turns over everyone, and the name is a promise to keep looking for the threads between people rather than the walls. Here, everyone has something in common.
My ChartsOne birth, read three ways.
The LibraryRooms to study, to write and to read.
The OracleA reading, only when it is asked for.
The ThroughlineYour own record, held over time.
